title: 1. Choose your weapon
description: Choose a Tier 1 one-handed weapon from this list. You have exactly enough Ore and Wood to craft one.

title: 2. Common base
description: The Common Base is the standard version of this weapon. It uses the recipe's base materials and determines the weapon type and its core attributes. New variants of a recipe can be unlocked by collecting Blueprints.

title: 3. Crafted item preview
description: Check the result before spending materials. The preview shows attribute ranges, starting Potential, quality chances, item identity, and possible Tempering attributes.

title: 4. Craft your weapon
description: The Common Base is selected and you have enough materials for one Tier 1 weapon. Craft it now; you can return to specialized Blueprints later.
